name: product-ux
description: Designs, critiques and builds product interfaces people use repeatedly: an evidence ledger instead of invented personas, job stories and top tasks, flows before screens, a state inventory for every view, sourced pattern rules for forms, navigation, feedback, tables, search, onboarding and AI features, a token-based visual system, a WCAG 2.2 and EAA floor, heuristic evaluation with severities and KLM estimates, and a dependency-free source scanner for unlabelled fields, fake buttons, blocked paste, deceptive consent, vague errors and other UI failures.
